text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I was looking something up on my phone, and all of a sudden, this weird thing popped up!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Something about viruses and my personal information… What's going to happen to me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look at her phone, and it's merely a pop-up ad.
choice_data_list: There's no problem. You can relax.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Whew, thank goodness… That really threw me for a loop.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I know I should learn how to use this thing properly, but it's just so hard to figure out. Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All that worrying really seems to have worn Maruzensky out…
